title: Indra's boon to Rama
introduction: When Indra the lord of celestials asks Rama for a boon, Rama requested Indra to bring back to life, all the monkeys who had lost their life in the battle. Indra grants the boon and all the dead monkeys are restored to life. The celestials disperse and the whole army of monkeys enjoy their well-earned rest.
closing: इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे आदिकाव्ये युद्धकाण्डे विंशत्यधिकशततमः सर्गः
Thus, this is the 120th chapter in Yuddha Kanda of Valmiki Ramayana, the First Epic poem of India.

verses.devanagari:
प्रतिप्रयाते काकुत्थ्से महेन्द्रः पाकशासनः |
अब्रवीत् परमप्रीतो राघवं प्राञ्जलिं स्थितम्
verses.iast:
pratiprayāte kākutthse mahendraḥ pākaśāsanaḥ |
abravīt paramaprīto rāghavaṃ prāJṇjaliṃ sthitam
verses.translation: When Dasaratha returned, the Lord Indra, the destroyer of Paka the demon, was very much pleased and spoke to Rama, who stood there with his oined palms.

verses.devanagari:
अमोघं दर्शनं राम तवास्माकं नरर्षभ |
प्रीतियुक्ताः स्म तेन त्वं ब्रूहि यन्मनसेप्सितम्
verses.iast:
amoghaṃ darśanaṃ rāma tavāsmākaṃ nararṣabha |
prītiyuktāḥ sma tena tvaṃ brūhi yanmanasepsitam
verses.translation: "O Rama, the foremost among men! Your sight of us, should not go in vain. Therefore, tell us whatever is desired by you."

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्तो महेन्द्रेण प्रसन्नेन महात्मना |
सुप्रसन्नमना हृष्टो वचनम् प्राह राघवः
verses.iast:
evamukto mahendreṇa prasannena mahātmanā |
suprasannamanā hṛṣṭo vacanam prāha rāghavaḥ
verses.translation: Hearing the words of the great souled Indra the lord of celestials, after having been pleased, Rama with the most placid mind spoke the following words with rejoice:

verses.devanagari:
यदि प्रीतिः समुत्पन्ना मयि ते विबुधेश्वर |
वक्ष्यामि कुरु मे सत्यम् वचनं वदतां वर
verses.iast:
yadi prītiḥ samutpannā mayi te vibudheśvara |
vakṣyāmi kuru me satyam vacanaṃ vadatāṃ vara
verses.translation: "O the foremst among the eloquent! O Indra! If you have affection in me, I shall speak out my words. Make my words real."

glosses.meaning: O the foremost among the eloquent!
if you have affection in me

verses.devanagari:
मम हेतोः पराक्रान्ता ये गता यमसादनम् |
ते सर्वे जीवितं प्राप्य समुत्तिष्ठन्तु वानराः
verses.iast:
mama hetoḥ parākrāntā ye gatā yamasādanam |
te sarve jīvitaṃ prāpya samuttiṣṭhantu vānarāḥ
verses.translation: "Let all the monkeys, who reached the abode of death, after displaying their energyfor

glosses.meaning: who reached the abode of Death

verses.devanagari:
मत्कृते विप्रयुक्ता ये पुत्रैर्दारैश्च वानराः |
तान् प्रीतमनसः सर्वान् द्रष्टुमिच्छामि मानद
verses.iast:
matkṛte viprayuktā ye putrairdāraiśca vānarāḥ |
tān prītamanasaḥ sarvān draṣṭumicchāmi mānada
verses.translation: "O the bestower of honour! I wish to see all those monkeys, who for my sake, were removed from their sons and wives, be delighted at heart."

verses.devanagari:
विक्रान्ताश्चापि शूराश्च न मृत्युं गणयन्ति च |
कृतयत्ना विपन्नाश्च जीवयैनान् पुरंदर
verses.iast:
vikrāntāścāpi śūrāśca na mṛtyuṃ gaṇayanti ca |
kṛtayatnā vipannāśca jīvayainān purandara
verses.translation: "They were all valiant, proving their energies and did not take their death into account. They made their strenuous efforts and died. O Indra! Restore their lives to them."

verses.devanagari:
मत्प्रियेष्वभिरक्ताश्च न मृत्युं गणयन्ति ये |
त्वत्प्रसादात्समेयुस्ते वरमेतमहं वृणे
verses.iast:
matpriyeṣvabhiraktāśca na mṛtyuṃ gaṇayanti ye |
tvatprasādātsameyuste varametamahaṃ vṛṇe
verses.translation: "Those mokeys - who coutned death as nothing and who were fond of doing favour to me - let them get re-united with their near and dear ones by your grace. I seek this boon of you."

glosses.meaning: and who were fond of doing favour to me

verses.devanagari:
नीरुजो निर्व्रणांश्चैव संपन्नबलपौरुषान् |
गोलाङ्गूलांस्तथर्क्षांश्च द्रष्टुमिच्छामि मानद
verses.iast:
nīrujo nirvraṇāṃścaiva sampannabalapauruṣān |
golāṇ^gūlāṃstatharkṣāṃśca draṣṭumicchāmi mānada
verses.translation: "O bestower of honour! I wish to see the monkeys and bears, free from wounds and pains, with augmented strength and valour."

glosses.meaning: and having augmented strength and valour.

verses.devanagari:
अकाले चापि पुष्पाणि मूलानि च फलानि च |
नद्यश्च विमलास्तत्र तिष्ठेयुर्यत्र वानराः
verses.iast:
akāle cāpi puṣpāṇi mūlāni ca phalāni ca |
nadyaśca vimalāstatra tiṣṭheyuryatra vānarāḥ
verses.translation: "Wherever the aforesaid monkeys live, let there be rivers with crystal-clear water, flowers, roots and fruits even in an off-season."

verses.devanagari:
श्रुत्वा तु वचनं तस्य राघवस्य महात्मनः |
महेन्द्रह् प्रत्युवाचेदं वचनं प्रीतिसंयुतम्
verses.iast:
śrutvā tu vacanaṃ tasya rāghavasya mahātmanaḥ |
mahendrah pratyuvācedaṃ vacanaṃ prītisaṃyutam
verses.translation: Hearing the words of that great-souled Rama, Indra the lord of celestials endowed as he was with delight, again spoke the following words:

verses.devanagari:
महानयं वरस्तात यस्त्वयोक्तो रघुत्तम |
द्विर्मया नोक्तपुर्वं च तस्मादेवद्भविष्यति
verses.iast:
mahānayaṃ varastāta yastvayokto raghuttama |
dvirmayā noktapurvaṃ ca tasmādevadbhaviṣyati
verses.translation: "O beloved Rama! This boon, which has been sought by you is hard to grant. No offer has, however, been revised by me in the past. Therefore this will come to be."

glosses.meaning: is very great (is hard to gratn)

verses.devanagari:
समुत्तिष्ठन्तु ते सर्वे हता ये युधि राक्षसैः |
ऋक्षाश्च सह गोपुच्छैर्निकृत्ताननबाहवः
verses.iast:
samuttiṣṭhantu te sarve hatā ye yudhi rākṣasaiḥ |
ṛkṣāśca saha gopucchairnikṛttānanabāhavaḥ
verses.translation: "Let all those monkeys and bears along with long-tailed monkeys, who have been killed in battle, by the demons and whose heads and arms have been severed, be alive and active again."

glosses.meaning: and whose heads and arms have been severed

verses.devanagari:
नीरुजो निर्व्रिणाश्चव संपन्नबलपौरुषाः |
समुत्थास्यन्ति हरयः सुप्ता निद्राक्षये यथा
verses.iast:
nīrujo nirvriṇāścava sampannabalapauruṣāḥ |
samutthāsyanti harayaḥ suptā nidrākṣaye yathā
verses.translation: "Without any ill-health andwounds and with boosted strength and valour, the monkeys will srise again, as those fallen asleep would do at the end of their sleep."

glosses.meaning: without any and with boosted strength and valour
at the end of their sleep.

verses.devanagari:
सुहृद्भिर्बान्धवैश्चव ज्ञातिभिः स्वजनेन च |
सर्व एव समेष्यन्ति संयुक्ताः परया मुदा
verses.iast:
suhṛdbhirbāndhavaiścava jJṇātibhiḥ svajanena ca |
sarva eva sameṣyanti saṃyuktāḥ parayā mudā
verses.translation: "All of them, full of delight, will get re-united with their friends, relatives, kinsmen and family members."

verses.devanagari:
अकाले पुष्पशबलाः फलवन्तश्च पादपाः |
भविष्यन्ति महेष्वास नद्यश्च नलिलायुताः
verses.iast:
akāle puṣpaśabalāḥ phalavantaśca pādapāḥ |
bhaviṣyanti maheṣvāsa nadyaśca nalilāyutāḥ
verses.translation: "O the wielder of a great bow! The trees will look colourful with flowers and fruits even in the off-season. Rivers too will remain constantly with water."

glosses.meaning: O the wielder of a great bow!

verses.devanagari:
सव्रणैः प्रथमं गात्रैरिदानीं निर्व्रणैः समैः |
ततः समुत्थिताः सर्वे सुप्त्वेव हरियूथपाः
बभूवुर्वानराः सर्वे किं न्वेतदिति विस्मिताः |
verses.iast:
savraṇaiḥ prathamaṃ gātrairidānīṃ nirvraṇaiḥ samaiḥ |
tataḥ samutthitāḥ sarve suptveva hariyūthapāḥ
babhūvurvānarāḥ sarve kiṃ nvetaditi vismitāḥ |
verses.translation: Thereupon, all those monkey-warriors got up, as if from a sleep, with all their limbs completely healed of wounds. All the monkeys felt surprised, saying to one another "What miracle is this?"

verses.devanagari:
काकुत्थ्सं परिपूर्णार्थं दृष्ट्वा सर्वे सुरोत्तमाः
अब्रुवन् परमप्रीताः स्तुत्वा रामं सलक्ष्मणम् |
verses.iast:
kākutthsaṃ paripūrṇārthaṃ dṛṣṭvā sarve surottamāḥ
abruvan paramaprītāḥ stutvā rāmaṃ salakṣmaṇam |
verses.translation: Seeing Rama, whose wish has been fully realised, all the foremost of celestials, with a great delight, spoke praisingly to Rama and Lakshmana:

glosses.meaning: whose wish has been fully realised

verses.devanagari:
गच्छायोध्यामितो राजन् विसर्जय च वानरान्
मैथिलीं सान्त्वयस्वैनामनुरक्तां यशस्विनीम् |
verses.iast:
gacchāyodhyāmito rājan visarjaya ca vānarān
maithilīṃ sāntvayasvaināmanuraktāṃ yaśasvinīm |
verses.translation: "O monarch! Proceed to Ayodhya from here and disband the monkeys. Reassure this illustrious and devoted Seetha."

verses.devanagari:
भ्रातरं भरतं पश्य त्वच्छोकाद्व्रतचारिणम्
शत्रुघ्नं च महात्मानं मातृइः सर्वाः परंतप |
अभिषेचय चात्मानम् पौरान्गत्वा प्रहर्षय
verses.iast:
bhrātaraṃ bharataṃ paśya tvacchokādvratacāriṇam
śatrughnaṃ ca mahātmānaṃ mātṛiḥ sarvāḥ parantapa |
abhiṣecaya cātmānam paurāngatvā praharṣaya
verses.translation: "O destroyer of adversaries! See Bharata, your brother, who is practising austerities through grief caused by separation from you, the great-souled Shatrughna and all your mohters. Get yourself consecrated on the throne. Bring rejoice to the citizens, by going there."

glosses.meaning: through frief caused by separation from you
get yourself consecrated on the throne

verses.devanagari:
एवमुक्त्वा सहस्राक्षो रामं सौमित्रिणा सह |
विमानैः सूर्यसंकाशैर्ययौ हृष्टः सुरैह् सह
verses.iast:
evamuktvā sahasrākṣo rāmaṃ saumitriṇā saha |
vimānaiḥ sūryasaṅkāśairyayau hṛṣṭaḥ suraih saha
verses.translation: Thus speaking to Rama and Lakshmana, Idnra the thousand-eyed god of celestials, having beenpleased, returned to heaven with other gods in their aerial cars, shining liek the sun.

glosses.meaning: Indra the thousand-eyed god of celestials

verses.devanagari:
अभिवाद्य च काकुत्थ्सः सर्वांस्तांस्त्रिदशोत्तमान् |
लक्ष्मणेन सह भ्रात्रा वासमाज्ञापयत्तदा
verses.iast:
abhivādya ca kākutthsaḥ sarvāṃstāṃstridaśottamān |
lakṣmaṇena saha bhrātrā vāsamājJṇāpayattadā
verses.translation: having respectfully saluted all those celestials, Rama along with Lakshmana his brother, then instructed all the monkeys to take rest in their respective places.

glosses.meaning: (all the monkeys) to take rest in their respective places.

verses.devanagari:
ततस्तु सा लक्ष्मणरानुपालिता |
महाचमूर्हृष्टजना यशस्विनी |
श्रिया ज्वलन्तीविरराज सर्वतो |
निशा प्रणीतेव हि शीतरश्मिना
verses.iast:
tatastu sā lakṣmaṇarānupālitā |
mahācamūrhṛṣṭajanā yaśasvinī |
śriyā jvalantīvirarāja sarvato |
niśā praṇīteva hi śītaraśminā
verses.translation: Thereupon, that illustrious and mighty army of rejoiced troops, for its part, whichw as protected by Lakshmana and Rama, and was blazing with splendour on all sides, shone brightly like the might, illumined by the moon.

glosses.meaning: which was protected by Lakshmana and Rama
